notes: A new Photoshop-style workspace for the 3D Livery tab: a menu bar, a tool rail (Select, Move, Scale, Rotate, Skew, Shapes, Pen) with its settings in a bar above the 3D view, a Precision setting that slows every drag, and one Layers panel on the right with eye and padlock toggles, drag to reorder, Ctrl and Shift multi-select, a right-click menu and a Link toggle. Export and project actions are icons in the top toolbar, buttons are clean green links, and values have drop-down sliders. The pen tool is much better: draw from a flat side view with no perspective, edit points and handles after drawing, freehand, fill and outline, mirror to the other side, grid, typed lengths, a live filled preview and Shift for a sharp corner then a new curve. Shapes remember their path so their points can be edited again later.
